description: The mentor charter, enforced by the harness rather than by good intentions. On 2026-08-24 the charter was loaded in context, in full, and the Mentor note was skipped anyway: a work request went straight to a `git fetch` with no note at all. A PROMPT YOU ARE HOLDING IS A PROMPT YOU CAN SKIP. So the charter no longer relies on being read. The per-message hook is the one that matters — the failure is per-message, not per-session, and a session-start greeting fires once and cannot stop turn 40 from skipping the note. If only one of these survives a future cleanup, keep UserPromptSubmit.

hooks.statusMessage: the first reply opens as your mentor
